ada.text: Hello, neighbours! I'm Ada, and I keep bees, so I know the apple trees well. Come spring, their blossoms are the first big feast for my hives, and the bees pay them back by pollinating every flower. A good orchard hums all April long, and in autumn the apples taste a little of that honey sweetness.

bo.text: Um... hello. The pond is quiet in the morning, and I like how the water holds the sky. I play a little music here sometimes, softly, so the ripples can keep it. Thank you for listening.
